Engineering fixtures with explicit provenance. nyc311_synthetic.jsonl contains 188 records (180 generated valid requests, two snapshot duplicates, five invalid records, one valid request with an unknown borough). All rows carry _source_kind=synthetic_fixture. These are not official NYC311 observations and must not be used for scientific conclusions. Fixed dates and values support offline deterministic tests. Source floating timestamps are America/New_York; _observed_at is UTC.

nyc311_official_sample.jsonl is a 12-row verbatim selected excerpt of the real API download. Its separate provenance JSON records source query/window checksums and observation times. This tiny excerpt is an engineering fixture, not a representative research sample. No street address fields were downloaded.
